items.title: Progress model: mirror names, plan items and the done share
items.action:
1. Copy docs/plans/2030/tests/tests/mods/test_working_refs_contract.py to tests/mods/.
2. mirror.ts: export RECEIPTS_DIR = 'receipts', DONE_OUTCOMES = ['complete', 'closed'] as const and DONE_STATUSES = ['COMPLETE', 'CLOSED_NO_ACTION'] as const (the `as const` form ts_string_array reads), with a header bullet naming harness_lib.plan_receipts and plan_enums.DONE.
3. plans.ts: PlanInfo gains items: PlanItem[] ({ id: string; status: string | null }), read leniently from data.items (non-objects and entries without a string id dropped; a non-string status is null).
4. New progress.ts, pure (no $): Progress = { done, total }; outcomeKindOf(text) parses a receipt and returns receipt.outcome then outcome.kind as a string, else null (absent or malformed text); progressOf(items, kinds) counts an item done when its kind is in DONE_OUTCOMES, or, with no kind, when item.status is in DONE_STATUSES (V6), total the item count; PLAN_RAMP = [51, 45, 74, 67, 243] (V1); planStep(p) per V2; planColor(p) = PLAN_RAMP[planStep(p)]; receiptsDirOf(plansDir, id); receiptsSignatureOf(byPlan) over each plan id and the name, size and mtime of each .json entry, sorted. Read item, receipt and outcome fields inline as item.<field>, receipt.<field>, outcome.<field> (the contract test pins those names).
5. progress.test.ts: every step boundary (0/4 step 0, 1/4 step 1, 2/4 step 2, 3/4 step 3, 4/4 step 4, no items step 0); complete and closed count, started and blocked do not; no receipt falls back to the status; a malformed receipt counts as none; no ramp color is in TODO_PALETTE or 240; the signature moves with a receipt's mtime. plans.test.ts: items parsed, malformed entries dropped.

items.title: Line colors: plan progress, issues, other branches and punctuation
items.action:
1. types/index.d.ts: PlanLink gains done and total (the plan's done share, plan 2030).
2. line.ts: LineView gains progress: ReadonlyMap<string, Progress> keyed by plan id; SHOW_ALL holds an empty map, and a plan missing from it takes progressOf(items, empty map). buildLine fills done and total on each PlanLink. statusText draws each plan number in planColor inside its OSC 8 link text, each issue number in 180 (V3), other branch names in 246 (V4), and the plan word, ' · ', ', ', '[ ', ' ]', the parentheses around issues and +N in DARK 240 (V5); TODO labels keep todoColor. Plain text, the cap, formatRefs and segmentText do not change.
3. line.test.ts: expectations for each colored piece; the escape-stripped ccstatusline form still equals the plain form; a plan at 0, partial and full progress draws 51, a middle step and 243.

items.title: Scan reads the receipts of the plans on the line and watches them
items.action:
1. watch.ts runScan: for each qualifying plan, read <plans>/<id>/receipts/<ITEM>.json for each item (absent: no kind), build the kinds map with outcomeKindOf, compute progressOf and pass the map to buildLine through viewOf. List each qualifying plan's receipts folder and keep receiptsSignatureOf and the qualifying ids in the memo (resetMemo clears both).
2. filesMoved also lists the receipts folders of the memo's plan ids and compares the signature, so a record moves the color at the next tool call; plans not on the line are not listed.
3. watch.test.ts: a qualifying receipts plan draws its number in its step color in line.txt and line.json; a new complete receipt followed by a Write tool call redraws it a step dimmer; the atom's plans carry done and total.

decisions.question: Where does a plan's done share come from?

options.summary: the mod reads the page's generated <id>/live.js
the harness writes a progress file per plan

decisions.rationale: developer pick (approach A, spec Approaches): receipts are committed and write-once, so the color is right on every checkout; live.js and a harness file are absent until rebuilt

decisions.question: Which way does the plan gradient run?

options.summary: bright while active, dim as items finish
dim at the start, bright when done

decisions.rationale: developer answer: a plan nearing its archive recedes

decisions.question: Which renderer gets the colors?
decisions.rationale: proposed in conversation, not corrected; band-line keeps its subtle one-color form

decisions.question: Does an item closed without action count as done?

options.summary: complete and closed count as done

decisions.rationale: proposed in conversation, not corrected; matches plan_enums.DONE

values.name: V1 plan ramp
values.source: spec Builder's calls; none in the TODO palette (39, 170, 36, 214, 141, 72, 203, 178)

values.name: V2 plan step
values.value: 0 when no item is done (and for a plan with no items), 4 when every item is done, else 1 + floor(3 * done / total)

values.name: V3 issue color
values.value: ANSI 256 color 180 on each issue number

values.name: V5 punctuation color
values.value: ANSI 256 color 240 on the plan word, the separators, brackets, commas, the parentheses around issues and +N

values.name: V6 done rule
values.value: a receipt whose outcome kind is complete or closed; with no receipt, an item status of COMPLETE or CLOSED_NO_ACTION
